description: This file Implements the 'Edit' feature for articles, including command validation, handling the update process of an article (such as title, description, body, tags), and managing related database operations.

classes.name: Edit
classes.description: Contains the command, validator, and handler class for editing articles.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the command to edit an article, updates its details, manages tags, and sauvegardes changes in the database.

methods.name: GetArticleTagsToCreate
methods.description: Determines which tags need to be added to an article during update.

methods.name: GetArticleTagsToDelete
methods.description: Determines which tags should be removed from an article during update.
